title: Audit-provenance run record (shape documentation)
description: One verification run tied to the inputs that produced it, so a passing gate is reproducible and auditable rather than a bare assertion. The authoritative validator is tools/provenance.py:validate_run_record; this schema documents the same shape so drift between the two is caught by scripts/tests/test_knowledge_quality_provenance.py. Phase 1 (Task 5.3) defines the form only; real run records are written by the Phase 2 pilot wiring (Task 7.3) into .private/knowledge-quality/runs/, none here. external_result keeps the three-state cross-repository vocabulary (a server that did not answer is INCONCLUSIVE, never a silent pass or defect). recovery_class records whether a failure of this run is undone by an ordinary revert (reversible) or published something a revert does not erase and needs a human-led incident response (incident).

validator_artifact_digests.description: Map of Hub validator path to its SHA-256 digest at the recorded revision.

tool_versions.description: Map of tool name to executed version, or 'not-run' with a reason for a tool not used.

action_shas.description: Full 40-character commit SHAs of the GitHub Actions used.

human_phase_decision.description: Reference to the private human phase-decision record; the decision itself is private.
